cases.sentence: Кто из ___, читая описания последнего периода кампании 1812 года, не испытывал тяжелого чувства досады, неудовлетворенности и неясности?
cases.explain: «русских людей» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: What Russian, reading the account of the last part of the campaign of 1812, has not experienced an uncomfortable feeling of regret, dissatisfaction, and perplexity? Who has not asked himself how it is that the French were not all captured or destroyed when our three armies surrounded them in superior numbers, when the disordered French, hungry and freezing, surrendered in crowds, and when (as the historians relate) the aim of the Russians was to stop the French, to cut them off, and capture them all?

cases.sentence: Кто из русских людей, читая описания ___ кампании 1812 года, не испытывал тяжелого чувства досады, неудовлетворенности и неясности?
cases.explain: «последнего периода» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: What Russian, reading the account of the last part of the campaign of 1812, has not experienced an uncomfortable feeling of regret, dissatisfaction, and perplexity? Who has not asked himself how it is that the French were not all captured or destroyed when our three armies surrounded them in superior numbers, when the disordered French, hungry and freezing, surrendered in crowds, and when (as the historians relate) the aim of the Russians was to stop the French, to cut them off, and capture them all?

cases.sentence: Каким образом то ___, которое, слабее числом французов, дало Бородинское сражение, каким образом это войско, с трех сторон окружавшее французов и имевшее целью их забрать, не достигло своей цели?
cases.explain: «русское войско» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: How was it that the Russian army, which when numerically weaker than the French had given battle at Borodinó, did not achieve its purpose when it had surrounded the French on three sides and when its aim was to capture them? Can the French be so enormously superior to us that when we had surrounded them with superior forces we could not beat them? How could that happen?

cases.sentence: Неужели такое ___ перед нами имеют французы, что мы, окружив их с превосходными силами, не могли побить их?
cases.explain: «громадное преимущество» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: How was it that the Russian army, which when numerically weaker than the French had given battle at Borodinó, did not achieve its purpose when it had surrounded the French on three sides and when its aim was to capture them? Can the French be so enormously superior to us that when we had surrounded them with superior forces we could not beat them? How could that happen?

cases.sentence: Неужели такое громадное преимущество перед нами имеют французы, что мы, окружив их с ___, не могли побить их?
cases.explain: «превосходными силами» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: How was it that the Russian army, which when numerically weaker than the French had given battle at Borodinó, did not achieve its purpose when it had surrounded the French on three sides and when its aim was to capture them? Can the French be so enormously superior to us that when we had surrounded them with superior forces we could not beat them? How could that happen?

cases.sentence: Почему-то ___, которое с слабейшими силами одержало победу под Бородиным над неприятелем во всей его силе, в превосходных силах, было побеждено под Красным и под Березиной расстроенными толпами французов?
cases.explain: «русское войско» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Why was the Russian army—which with inferior forces had withstood the enemy in full strength at Borodinó—defeated at Krásnoe and the Berëzina by the disorganized crowds of the French when it was numerically superior?

cases.sentence: Цель эта не имела никакого смысла во-первых потому, что расстроенная армия Наполеона со всею ___ бежала из России, т. е. исполняла то самое, чего мог желать всякий русский.
cases.explain: «возможной быстротой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: It would have been senseless, first because Napoleon’s disorganized army was flying from Russia with all possible speed, that is to say, was doing just what every Russian desired. So what was the use of performing various operations on the French who were running away as fast as they possibly could?

cases.sentence: Для чего же было делать ___ над французами, которые бежали так быстро, как только они могли?
cases.explain: «различные операции» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: It would have been senseless, first because Napoleon’s disorganized army was flying from Russia with all possible speed, that is to say, was doing just what every Russian desired. So what was the use of performing various operations on the French who were running away as fast as they possibly could?

cases.sentence: Во-вторых невозможно было потому, что, для того чтобы парализировать ту силу инерции, с которою двигалось назад войско Наполеона, надо было без сравнения ___, чем те, которые имели русские.
cases.explain: «бо̀льшие войска» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Secondly it was impossible, because to paralyze the momentum with which Napoleon’s army was retiring, incomparably greater forces than the Russians possessed would have been required.

cases.sentence: В-третьих, невозможно это было потому, что ___ отрезать, не имеет никакого смысла.
cases.explain: «военное слово» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Thirdly it was impossible, because the military term “to cut off” has no meaning. One can cut off a slice of bread, but not an army. To cut off an army—to bar its road—is quite impossible, for there is always plenty of room to avoid capture and there is the night when nothing can be seen, as the military scientists might convince themselves by the example of Krásnoe and of the Berëzina. It is only possible to capture prisoners if they agree to be captured, just as it is only possible to catch a swallow if it settles on one’s hand. Men can only be taken prisoners if they surrender according to the rules of strategy and tactics, as the Germans did. But the French troops quite rightly did not consider that this suited them, since death by hunger and cold awaited them in flight or captivity alike.

cases.sentence: Но ___ совершенно справедливо не находили этого удобным, так как одинаковая голодная и холодная смерть ожидала их на бегстве и в плену.
cases.explain: «французские войска» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Thirdly it was impossible, because the military term “to cut off” has no meaning. One can cut off a slice of bread, but not an army. To cut off an army—to bar its road—is quite impossible, for there is always plenty of room to avoid capture and there is the night when nothing can be seen, as the military scientists might convince themselves by the example of Krásnoe and of the Berëzina. It is only possible to capture prisoners if they agree to be captured, just as it is only possible to catch a swallow if it settles on one’s hand. Men can only be taken prisoners if they surrender according to the rules of strategy and tactics, as the Germans did. But the French troops quite rightly did not consider that this suited them, since death by hunger and cold awaited them in flight or captivity alike.

cases.sentence: В движении русской армии от Тарутина до Красного выбыло пятьдесят тысяч больными и отсталыми, т. е. число равное населению большого ___.
cases.explain: «губернского города» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: During the movement of the Russian army from Tarútino to Krásnoe it lost fifty thousand sick or stragglers, that is a number equal to the population of a large provincial town. Half the men fell out of the army without a battle.

cases.sentence: Во-вторых, цель эта достигалась действиями ___, уничтожавшей французов, и в-третьих тем, что большая русская армия шла следом за французами, готовая употребить силу в случае остановки движения французов.
cases.explain: «народной войны» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The people had a single aim: to free their land from invasion. That aim was attained in the first place of itself, as the French ran away, and so it was only necessary not to stop their flight. Secondly it was attained by the guerrilla warfare which was destroying the French, and thirdly by the fact that a large Russian army was following the French, ready to use its strength in case their movement stopped.

cases.sentence: И ___ знал, что самое выгодное держать кнут поднятым, угрожая им, а не по голове стегать бегущее животное.
cases.explain: «опытный погонщик» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The Russian army had to act like a whip to a running animal. And the experienced driver knew it was better to hold the whip raised as a menace than to strike the running animal on the head.
